import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.lines as mlines
import numpy as np
import json

# ---- Dark theme Tufte config ----
plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.facecolor": "#151515",
    "axes.facecolor": "#151515",
    "text.color": "#ddd",
    "axes.labelcolor": "#999",
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Georgia", "DejaVu Serif", "Palatino"],
    "font.size": 11,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#151515",
    "savefig.dpi": 200,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.3,
})

# ---- Load data ----
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes = data["ml_architecture"]["nodes"]
edges = data["ml_architecture"]["edges"]

# ---- Category colors (dark-mode muted) ----
category_colors = {
    "data-layer": "#5a9bd5",
    "compute-layer": "#5cb88a",
    "serving-layer": "#e8993e",
    "observability-layer": "#d95f5f",
}

# ---- Custom layout positions ----
positions = {
    "data_platform":     (0.0, 0.0),
    "feature_store":     (2.8, 0.0),
    "training_cluster":  (5.6, 0.0),
    "model_registry":    (8.4, 0.0),
    "inference_online":  (11.4, 1.5),
    "inference_offline": (11.4, -1.5),
    "ab_experiment":     (14.4, 0.0),
    "monitoring":        (17.2, 0.0),
    "version_control":   (4.2, -4.2),
}

# ---- Node dimensions based on criticality ----
def node_dims(crit):
    s = 0.75 + (crit - 7) * 0.12
    return 1.8 * s, 0.9 * s

node_sizes = {n["id"]: node_dims(n["criticality"]) for n in nodes}

# ---- Edge width from throughput ----
def edge_lw(throughput):
    return 0.6 + (throughput / 12.5) * 2.8

# ---- Intersection of ray from center with rectangle boundary ----
def rect_boundary_point(cx, cy, w, h, angle):
    cos_a = np.cos(angle)
    sin_a = np.sin(angle)
    hw, hh = w / 2, h / 2
    if abs(cos_a) < 1e-9:
        return cx, cy + hh * np.sign(sin_a)
    if abs(sin_a) < 1e-9:
        return cx + hw * np.sign(cos_a), cy
    tx = hw / abs(cos_a)
    ty = hh / abs(sin_a)
    t = min(tx, ty)
    return cx + t * cos_a, cy + t * sin_a

# ---- Create figure ----
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20, 11))
ax.set_xlim(-2.0, 19.5)
ax.set_ylim(-6.0, 4.0)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ---- Draw edges (layered: lineage -> feedback -> primary) ----
flow_zorder = {"lineage": 2, "feedback": 3, "primary": 4}
sorted_edges = sorted(edges, key=lambda e: flow_zorder.get(e["flow_type"], 2))

for edge in sorted_edges:
    src_id = edge["source"]
    tgt_id = edge["target"]
    flow = edge["flow_type"]
    throughput = edge["throughput_gbps"]
    label = edge["label"]

    sx, sy = positions[src_id]
    tx, ty = positions[tgt_id]
    sw, sh = node_sizes[src_id]
    tw, th = node_sizes[tgt_id]

    lw = edge_lw(throughput)

    if flow == "primary":
        style = "-"
        color = "#7a7a7a"
        alpha = 0.75
        head_w, head_l = 8, 6
    elif flow == "feedback":
        style = (0, (5, 3))
        color = "#d95f5f"
        alpha = 0.85
        lw = max(lw, 1.2)
        head_w, head_l = 8, 6
    elif flow == "lineage":
        style = (0, (2, 3))
        color = "#5a9bd5"
        alpha = 0.55
        lw = max(lw * 0.65, 0.6)
        head_w, head_l = 6, 5

    # Compute start/end points and connection style
    # Special routing for feedback and cross-pipeline edges
    connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=0"

    if flow == "feedback":
        # Feedback edges curve below the pipeline
        # Start from bottom of monitoring, end at bottom of target
        start = (sx, sy - sh / 2)
        end = (tx, ty - th / 2)
        if tgt_id == "data_platform":
            connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=5.5"
        elif tgt_id == "training_cluster":
            connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=3.8"
    elif flow == "lineage":
        # Lineage edges from version control go upward
        if src_id == "version_control":
            start = (sx, sy + node_sizes[src_id][1] / 2)
            end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th,
                                      np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx))
            if tgt_id == "feature_store":
                connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=0.3"
            elif tgt_id == "training_cluster":
                connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.2"
            elif tgt_id == "model_registry":
                connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.5"
        elif src_id == "data_platform" and tgt_id == "version_control":
            start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh,
                                        np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx))
            end = (tx, ty + node_sizes[tgt_id][1] / 2)
            connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.3"
        else:
            angle_to_target = np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx)
            angle_to_source = np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx)
            start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh, angle_to_target)
            end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th, angle_to_source)
    else:
        # Primary edges
        if src_id == "feature_store" and tgt_id == "inference_online":
            # Cross-pipeline edge — route above
            start = (sx, sy + sh / 2)
            end = (tx, ty - th / 2 + 0.1)
            connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=3.0"
        elif src_id == "model_registry":
            if tgt_id == "inference_online":
                start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh,
                                            np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx))
                end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th,
                                          np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx))
                connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=0.25"
            elif tgt_id == "inference_offline":
                start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh,
                                            np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx))
                end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th,
                                          np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx))
                connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.25"
            else:
                angle_to_target = np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx)
                angle_to_source = np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx)
                start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh, angle_to_target)
                end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th, angle_to_source)
        elif src_id == "inference_online" and tgt_id == "ab_experiment":
            start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh,
                                        np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx))
            end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th,
                                      np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx))
            connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.2"
        elif src_id == "inference_offline" and tgt_id == "ab_experiment":
            start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh,
                                        np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx))
            end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th,
                                      np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx))
            connectionstyle = "arc3,rad=0.2"
        else:
            angle_to_target = np.arctan2(ty - sy, tx - sx)
            angle_to_source = np.arctan2(sy - ty, sx - tx)
            start = rect_boundary_point(sx, sy, sw, sh, angle_to_target)
            end = rect_boundary_point(tx, ty, tw, th, angle_to_source)

    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(
        posA=start, posB=end,
        arrowstyle=f"->,head_length={head_l},head_width={head_w}",
        connectionstyle=connectionstyle,
        linestyle=style,
        color=color,
        alpha=alpha,
        linewidth=lw,
        mutation_scale=1,
        zorder=flow_zorder.get(flow, 2),
    )
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

    # ---- Edge label placement ----
    if flow == "feedback":
        if tgt_id == "data_platform":
            # Label near the apex of the deep curve
            mid_x = 8.6
            mid_y = -3.2
        elif tgt_id == "training_cluster":
            mid_x = 12.0
            mid_y = -2.2
        else:
            mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2
            mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2 - 0.5
        lbl_color = "#d95f5f"
        lbl_fs = 8
    elif flow == "lineage":
        if src_id == "version_control":
            mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2
            mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2
            if tgt_id == "feature_store":
                mid_x = 3.2
                mid_y = -1.8
            elif tgt_id == "training_cluster":
                mid_x = 4.8
                mid_y = -1.8
            elif tgt_id == "model_registry":
                mid_x = 6.5
                mid_y = -1.8
        elif src_id == "data_platform" and tgt_id == "version_control":
            mid_x = 1.8
            mid_y = -2.0
        else:
            mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2
            mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2
        lbl_color = "#5a9bd5"
        lbl_fs = 7.5
    else:
        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2
        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2 + 0.25
        lbl_color = "#aaa"
        lbl_fs = 8.5

        # Special placement for cross-pipeline edge
        if src_id == "feature_store" and tgt_id == "inference_online":
            mid_x = 7.0
            mid_y = 2.8
        if src_id == "model_registry" and tgt_id == "inference_online":
            mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2 + 0.1
            mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2 + 0.2
        if src_id == "model_registry" and tgt_id == "inference_offline":
            mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2 + 0.1
            mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2 - 0.35

    ax.text(
        mid_x, mid_y, label,
        fontsize=lbl_fs, color=lbl_color, alpha=0.85,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', zorder=6,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='#151515',
                  edgecolor='none', alpha=0.8),
    )

# ---- Draw nodes ----
for node in nodes:
    nid = node["id"]
    x, y = positions[nid]
    w, h = node_sizes[nid]
    cat = node["category"]
    crit = node["criticality"]
    color = category_colors[cat]

    # Subtle glow for critical nodes (>=9)
    if crit >= 9:
        glow = FancyBboxPatch(
            (x - w / 2 - 0.05, y - h / 2 - 0.05), w + 0.10, h + 0.10,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
            facecolor=color, alpha=0.07,
            edgecolor="none",
            zorder=3,
        )
        ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Node box
    box = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=color, alpha=0.13,
        edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.8,
        zorder=5,
    )
    ax.add_patch(box)

    # Node label (multi-line)
    lines = node["label"].split("\n")
    total_lines = len(lines)
    line_height = 0.18
    start_y = y + (total_lines - 1) * line_height / 2

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        fs = 10.5 if i == 0 else 8.5
        fw = "bold" if i == 0 else "normal"
        ax.text(
            x, start_y - i * line_height, line,
            fontsize=fs, color=color, fontweight=fw,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', zorder=6,
        )

    # Sub-components below the node
    sub_text = "  |  ".join(node["sub_components"][:3])
    ax.text(
        x, y - h / 2 - 0.15, sub_text,
        fontsize=6.5, color='#888', alpha=0.6,
        ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='serif', zorder=6,
    )

    # Criticality badge (top-right corner)
    ax.text(
        x + w / 2 - 0.08, y + h / 2 - 0.1, str(crit),
        fontsize=7, color='#ddd', alpha=0.45,
        ha='right', va='top', fontfamily='serif', zorder=6,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', facecolor='#333',
                  edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5),
    )

# ---- Title ----
fig.text(
    0.02, 0.97,
    "ML Infrastructure Pipeline: End-to-End Directed Architecture",
    fontsize=20, fontfamily='serif', color='#ddd', fontweight='bold',
    va='top', ha='left',
)
fig.text(
    0.02, 0.935,
    "Sequential data flow from ingestion through monitoring with closed-loop feedback and cross-cutting lineage tracking",
    fontsize=12, fontfamily='serif', color='#999', va='top', ha='left',
)

# ---- Legend ----
legend_x = 0.02
legend_y_start = 0.095
spacing = 0.023

cat_labels = [
    ("Data Layer", "#5a9bd5"),
    ("Compute Layer", "#5cb88a"),
    ("Serving Layer", "#e8993e"),
    ("Observability", "#d95f5f"),
]
for i, (lbl, clr) in enumerate(cat_labels):
    yp = legend_y_start - i * spacing
    fig.patches.append(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (legend_x, yp - 0.004), 0.012, 0.012,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
        facecolor=clr, alpha=0.5, edgecolor=clr, linewidth=0.5,
        transform=fig.transFigure, figure=fig,
    ))
    fig.text(legend_x + 0.02, yp + 0.002, lbl,
             fontsize=9, color='#999', fontfamily='serif', va='center',
             transform=fig.transFigure)

edge_legend_x = 0.14
edge_items = [
    ("Primary flow", "-", "#7a7a7a"),
    ("Feedback loop", "--", "#d95f5f"),
    ("Data lineage", ":", "#5a9bd5"),
]
for i, (lbl, ls, clr) in enumerate(edge_items):
    yp = legend_y_start - i * spacing + 0.002
    fig.lines.append(mlines.Line2D(
        [edge_legend_x, edge_legend_x + 0.025], [yp, yp],
        color=clr, linestyle=ls, linewidth=2, alpha=0.75,
        transform=fig.transFigure, figure=fig,
    ))
    fig.text(edge_legend_x + 0.035, yp, lbl,
             fontsize=9, color='#999', fontfamily='serif', va='center',
             transform=fig.transFigure)

fig.text(
    0.30, legend_y_start + 0.002,
    "Node size ~ criticality (7-10)  |  Edge thickness ~ throughput (Gbps)  |  Badge = criticality score",
    fontsize=8.5, color='#666', fontfamily='serif', va='center',
    transform=fig.transFigure,
)

# ---- Annotations ----
# Online / Offline branching
ax.annotate(
    "Online / Offline\nBranching",
    xy=(9.9, 0.8), xytext=(9.9, 3.2),
    fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic', color='#e8993e', alpha=0.6,
    fontfamily='serif', ha='center', va='center',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color='#e8993e', lw=0.5, alpha=0.3),
    zorder=6,
)

# Feedback loop
ax.annotate(
    "Closed-Loop\nFeedback",
    xy=(10.5, -2.5), xytext=(10.5, -4.8),
    fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic', color='#d95f5f', alpha=0.6,
    fontfamily='serif', ha='center', va='center',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color='#d95f5f', lw=0.5, alpha=0.3),
    zorder=6,
)

# ---- Load data ----

    data = json.load(f)

nodes = data["ml_architecture"]["nodes"]
edges = data["ml_architecture"]["edges"]

# ---- Category colors (dark-mode muted) ----
category_colors = {
    "data-layer": "#5a9bd5",
    "compute-layer": "#5cb88a",
    "serving-layer": "#e8993e",
    "observability-layer": "#d95f5f",
}

# ---- Custom layout positions ----
positions = {
    "data_platform":     (0.0, 0.0),
    "feature_store":     (2.8, 0.0),
    "training_cluster":  (5.6, 0.0),
    "model_registry":    (8.4, 0.0),
    "inference_online":  (11.4, 1.5),
    "inference_offline": (11.4, -1.5),
    "ab_experiment":     (14.4, 0.0),
    "monitoring":        (17.2, 0.0),
    "version_control":   (4.2, -4.2),
}

# ---- Node dimensions based on criticality ----
def node_dims(crit):
    s = 0.75 + (crit - 7) * 0.12
    return 1.8 * s, 0.9 * s

node_sizes = {n["id"]: node_dims(n["criticality"]) for n in nodes}

# ---- Edge width from throughput ----
def edge_lw(throughput):
    return 0.6 + (throughput / 12.5) * 2.8

# ---- Intersection of ray from center with rectangle boundary ----
def rect_boundary_point(cx, cy, w, h, angle):
    cos_a = np.cos(angle)
    sin_a = np.sin(angle)
    hw, hh = w / 2, h / 2
    if abs(cos_a) < 1e-9:
        return cx, cy + hh * np.sign(sin_a)
    if abs(sin_a) < 1e-9:
        return cx + hw * np.sign(cos_a), cy
    tx = hw / abs(cos_a)
    ty = hh / abs(sin_a)
    t = min(tx, ty)
    return cx + t * cos_a, cy + t * sin_a
